name: preptrace
description: AI Interview Prep Kit — turns a job description into a personalized, researched interview preparation system.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @preptrace/api" "npm run dev -w @preptrace/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @preptrace/api && npm run build -w @preptrace/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @preptrace/shared && npm run test -w @preptrace/api
